text:
sophia: quick heads-up — noticed some odd behavior on the console at small widths (esp < 520px). metrics cards start stacking into two columns, table body gets a horizontal scrollbar but row actions are pushed off-screen. sidebar collapses but menu button overlaps the page title. attaching repro steps below (no screenshot).

liam: thanks. which page / which device? i can repro on iPhone SE emulation.

sophia: Dashboard > Project Overview. Steps: 1) open on 375px width 2) expand any table with >3 cols 3) toggle sidebar collapsed. Observed: card grid becomes ragged, table shows `overflow-x: auto` but action menu icon is outside the scroller so you can’t reach it.

anya: two quick suggestions from design: 1) switch cards to a single-column stacked list below 480px instead of two cramped columns; 2) add a persistent table header and enable per-row overflow overlay (a fade + '...' affordance) so actions stay reachable. also copy: use `Expand metrics` instead of `Show more` for clarity on small screens.

mike: engineering note — the action buttons are absolutely positioned relative to the table container right now. if we move them inside the scroll container they'll scroll horizontally. alternative: keep action column fixed with `position: sticky; right: 0;` but that breaks on some Android webviews.

maya: accessibility nit — if we add a sticky action column we need to ensure keyboard focus can reach those buttons. prefer an explicit `Show actions` toggle per row that opens a popover (aria-haspopup + aria-expanded). also ensure focus trap is not introduced.

liam: CSS idea (quick prototype):
```
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  .table-wrapper { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
  .row-actions { position: relative; min-width: 72px; }
}
```
This keeps actions in flow and lets the rightmost column be reachable via scroll.

mike: ok that helps. for the popover approach we can implement a small ARIA-friendly menu component (enter/space to open, esc to close). i can own it but need a design spec for small screens. anya can you sketch the popover states?

anya: will do. i’ll drop two micro-interactions: 1) inline popover anchored to action icon; 2) a full-row context sheet for <360px (full width modal from bottom). both with visible focus outlines and 44px hit targets.

sophia: copy tweak confirmed: `Expand metrics` for collapsed card; `View actions` for row toggle. also please add an off-screen aria-label for the collapsed sidebar button: `Toggle navigation, currently collapsed` when collapsed, `Toggle navigation, currently expanded` otherwise.

mike: timeline — small CSS/layout tweaks + aria-label on sidebar button = 1 day. popover + keyboard handling = 2-3 days. will PR the CSS fix first.

maya: QA checklist for PR: 1) keyboard nav + tab order 2) screenreader announcement for popover open 3) contrast checks for gradients used on horizontal scroll hint 4) touch targets >= 44px.

sophia: great. lets ship the CSS fix as a hotpatch to staging, then follow with the popover. @product — we'll monitor metrics for navigation clicks and any regressions. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `fix/mobile-table-actions` to staging — build 2198.

liam: i'll test on Android emulators and a real iPhone SE once the build lands.

anya: thanks — i'll attach micro-interaction frames in Figma and drop the link in this thread when ready. :sparkles:
